title: Staff Product Manager [Accounting expertise] 🇩🇪
description:
Join us as a Product Manager to build the accounting products that will make Qonto the default finance workspace for SMEs across Germany and beyond.
You'll own our accounting expansion in the German market end-to-end - shaping the product strategy, deepening our local offering, and defining what we build next - in one of the most fragmented and locally complex domains in fintech: German accounting, bookkeeping, and the DATEV ecosystem.
You will report to Paul Mourot, Head of Product for Accounting.

➡️ What you'll do
Own your product roadmap end-to-end: Define what we build, why, and in what order - working with engineers, designers, and domain experts to ship features that make a real difference for SMEs and their accountants in Germany.
Go deep on German accounting workflows and develop a sharp understanding of how accounting actually works in Germany.
Define and execute the German accounting strategy by understanding customer needs, evaluating what to build vs. partner on, and shaping an offer that's genuinely useful to German SMEs, not just a localized version of what works elsewhere.
Ship faster with AI: Use AI tools (Dust, Notion AI, Claude) and leverage AI as a product lever, identifying where automation and intelligence can transform accounting from a chore into a competitive advantage.
Challenge the status quo: Question assumptions, prototype fast, and push for the best possible product.
Work with maximum squad autonomy: Your squad owns its roadmap, picks its approaches, and ships independently. No layers of approval, no waiting on committees.

➡️ What we're looking for
Deep German accounting domain expertise as you've worked at or closely with a German accounting-tech company.
Concrete examples of products you took from 0 to 1 or significantly scaled. You think in outcomes, not features, and you're comfortable making hard trade-offs.
AI-native workflow: You use AI to supercharge how you work - from research and analysis to spec writing and user testing. You see AI as a product lever, not just a productivity hack.
German fluency, strong English: You're able to navigate the German market natively - accounting is intensely local, and firsthand understanding of the landscape matters. Strong English is required to work cross-functionally across Qonto's European teams.

➡️ What we can offer you
A market being completely transformed: You'll be building Qonto's accounting offer in this market from the ground up and shaping the strategy.
Squad autonomy as the default: You own your decisions and ship without red tape. No committees, no approval chains.
Unlimited access to the best AI tools: Claude, Dust, Notion AI, Cursor, Copilot - every tool you need, no permission required.

➡️ Your future manager
Your manager will be Paul Mourot, Head of Product for Accounting.
His path? Paul was CPO and co-founder at Semana (3+ years), Head of Product at BCG Digital Ventures, and CPO at Tiime - an accounting-tech platform - for nearly 4 years. Before that, he led product at AppTurbo, managing a team of designers, data analysts, and POs. He joined Qonto in 2025 to build the accounting product line. He knows the accounting domain from the inside, he's built products for it before.
What does he bring to the team? Real ownership for his PMs. You define the vision for your scope and you're accountable for the results. His approach: hire great people, give them context and autonomy, and create an environment where the best ideas win.

title: Regional Vice President, Sales - Northeast
description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation - building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

THE ROLE

As the RVP of Sales for our APAC sales team, you’ll be responsible for opening up the APAC region, and own and scaling revenue in our Enterprise segment. You’ll manage a team of quota-carrying AEs, drive forecast accuracy, and operationalize a repeatable sales motion.

This role sits at the intersection of execution and optimization: coaching reps to win today while tightening the systems that support growth tomorrow.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

REVENUE OWNERSHIP

- Own a Enterprise revenue number and deliver consistent, predictable growth

- Ensure healthy pipeline coverage and strong conversion across all stages

- Support deals through late-stage execution, pricing, and close

- Deliver accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts

- Create new processes, sales motions, and programs to drive pipeline and bookings

TEAM MANAGEMENT

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Enterprise Account Executives

- Drive best practices in discovery, MEDDICC, and value-based selling

- Run 1:1s, pipeline reviews, deal reviews, and forecast calls

- Hire and ramp new AEs in partnership with Enablement

PROCESS & SCALE

- Standardize and improve the Enterprise sales motion

- Partner with RevOps to optimize CRM hygiene, dashboards, and KPIs

- Collaborate with Marketing on lead quality, campaigns, and conversion

- Partner with Customer Success on handoffs, expansion signals, and renewals

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL IMPACT

- Provide structured feedback to Product on roadmap gaps and buyer objections

- Surface competitive insights and positioning to GTM leadership

- Contribute to pricing, packaging, and territory strategy as we scale

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

EXPERIENCE

- 10+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including 4+ years managing AEs

- Proven success selling to Enterprise and Strategic accounts (5,000+ employees)

- Experience in Series A-C environments with defined but evolving processes

- Background selling technical, DevTools, or developer-adjacent products preferred

SKILLS

- Strong forecasting discipline and pipeline inspection skills

- Excellent sales coaching and deal strategy capabilities

- Comfort selling into technical buyers (Engineering, DevOps, Platform teams)

- Data-driven, systems-minded approach to sales management

LEADERSHIP STYLE

- High accountability, low ego

- Servant leader

- Hands on but not a micromanager

- Coach-first mindset with a bias toward action

- Able to balance speed with rigor

This role is based in Sydney or Melbourne, Australia

title: Associate Director, Validation
description:
Ocular Therapeutix, Inc. (NASDAQ:OCUL) is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the formulation, development, and commercialization of innovative therapies for diseases and conditions of the eye using its proprietary bioresorbable hydrogel-based formulation technology, ELUTYX™. Ocular Therapeutix has built a robust product pipeline of drug delivery solutions developed to reduce the complexity and burden of the current standard of care and position itself to become a leader in the ophthalmic space.

Outside of the ophthalmic realm and behind the doors of our headquarters in Bedford, MA, we strive to build a strong culture where employees can flourish and achieve their career goals. We encourage out of the box thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and creativity.

Position Summary :

The Associate Director, Validation provides strategic and technical leadership for validation activities supporting the clinical development, process qualification, regulatory approval, and commercialization of Ocular Therapeutix products. The Associate Director is responsible for developing and executing validation strategies that demonstrate manufacturing processes, packaging configurations, and product distribution systems are capable, reproducible, and maintained in a state of control throughout the product lifecycle. This individual will play a critical leadership role in PPQ planning and execution, NDA readiness, commercial launch preparation, and ongoing lifecycle management of validated processes.

The Associate Director will serve as a validation subject matter expert during regulatory inspections, health authority interactions, audits, and CMC discussions and will maintain current knowledge of evolving regulatory expectations and industry practices related to process validation, lifecycle management, shipping validation, packaging validation, and continued process verification.

• Develop and maintain product-specific validation plans, PPQ strategies, protocols, reports, risk assessments, sampling plans, and acceptance criteria.

• Lead cross-functional planning and execution of PPQ campaigns to support regulatory approval, commercial launch, and ongoing product lifecycle management.

• Ensure validation strategies appropriately integrate process development knowledge, process characterization, control strategies, equipment readiness, analytical readiness, and manufacturing experience.

• Develop and oversee cold chain shipping and distribution validation strategies, including shipping configurations, temperature-controlled transportation, shipping lane qualification, thermal studies, and temperature excursion assessment.

• Provide validation leadership for packaging processes and systems supporting commercial product configuration, transportation, distribution, and product protection.

• Serve as a Validation Subject Matter Expert during regulatory inspections, audits, and CMC discussions.

• Provide technical leadership for validation-related deviations, investigations, change controls, risk assessments, and impact assessments.

• Maintain current knowledge of evolving regulatory requirements and industry practices and drive continuous improvement of validation systems and lifecycle approaches.

title: Compensation Analyst
description:
The Compensation Analyst designs and runs Omilia 's sales compensation programme end to end, from plan architecture through to the reporting infrastructure that keeps it accurate every cycle. This role owns both strategy and execution - building compensation plans and SPIFFs from scratch, then running the mechanisms that calculate, track and report on them. Reporting into Revenue Operations, this role partners closely with Sales, Finance and Payroll to keep compensation accurate, timely and aligned to revenue goals.
Accountabilities

• Own end-to-end design of sales compensation plans and incentive structures aligned to revenue goals.

• Own the full SPIFF programme lifecycle, from design and launch through payout and ROI retrospective.

• Own the comp calculation, payout and reporting infrastructure that keeps compensation accurate every cycle.

• Own compensation plan documentation, quota assignments and plan change history.

• Own cross-functional alignment with Sales, Finance and Payroll on plan design, quota setting and payout accuracy.

Key Responsibilities
Design and build sales compensation plans and incentive structures aligned to revenue goals.

• Model plan scenarios and payout economics to test affordability and behavioural impact before rollout.

• Recommend plan changes based on performance data and market benchmarking.

• Design, build and launch SPIFF programmes, defining mechanics, eligibility, targets and payout structure.

• Track SPIFF performance in-flight and report on ROI against target behaviour.

• Run the end-to-end comp calculation and payout process each cycle.

• Build and maintain the reporting infrastructure and mechanisms needed to run comp accurately at scale.

• Build dashboards and reports for comp attainment, plan performance and SPIFF ROI.

• Partner with Finance on accruals, forecasting and comp cost analysis.

• Partner with RevOps on the CRM data integrity that feeds every calculation, and flag design issues, payout errors or gaming risk before they escalate.

Requirements

Required:

• Experience designing and administering sales compensation plans in a B2B SaaS environment.

• Direct experience building and running SPIFF programmes end to end.

• Strong Excel and analytical modelling skills.

• Comfortable owning both the strategic design and the operational mechanics of a compensation programme.

Nice to have:

title: Senior Sales Engineer, Remote
description:
About RudderStack

RudderStack helps companies build on top of their own data. Our warehouse-native Customer Data Platform enables engineering, data, and AI teams to collect, unify, govern, and activate customer data while maintaining full ownership and control. By running directly on top of the customer's cloud data warehouse or lakehouse, RudderStack reduces data movement, improves governance, lowers infrastructure costs, and accelerates modern data and AI initiatives.

Leading companies including Lovable, Jaguar Land Rover, and Foot Locker trust RudderStack to power mission-critical customer data infrastructure.

We're now in the middle of one of the most significant shifts in the company's history: evolving from the industry's leading warehouse-native CDP into a fully Agentic CDP built for the AI era - a platform that doesn't just collect and activate customer data, but reasons over it and takes action on our customers' behalf. EMEA is a critical part of that next chapter, and this hire will help define it.

About the role

• We're looking for a Senior Sales Engineer who can sit across the table from an engineering leader, understand the customer data problem they're actually trying to solve, and show them how RudderStack solves it.

• This is a pre-sales role. You'll own the technical relationship during the evaluation, running discovery, designing and delivering proofs of concept, navigating security and architecture reviews, and building the technical case that wins the deal. You'll work alongside Account Executives on our largest and most complex opportunities, and you'll hand off to Customer Success once the customer is live.

• You'd be joining a team of engineers who care about data, about the community around it, and about making life easier for the people who use our product. We care deeply about our customers, and we judge ourselves on how well we serve them.
*Our roles are remote first, and can be based anywhere in the US (.

What you'll do

• Own the technical workstream on new business and expansion opportunities, from first technical call through to signed contract and handoff to Customer Success.

• Run technical discovery to understand a prospect's current stack, data architecture, and the business outcomes they're trying to reach, then map those to a concrete RudderStack solution.

• Design, build, and deliver proofs of concept and demos tailored to the customer's actual use case, not a canned script.

• Lead architecture conversations on data governance, identity resolution, customer 360, and warehouse design, and defend those designs to technical buyers.

• Navigate security reviews, RFPs, and technical due diligence alongside the account team.

• Develop deep subject matter expertise on the customer data landscape and RudderStack 's role within it.

• Act as a trusted advisor who can influence a prospect's customer data strategy, not just answer questions about our product.

• Bring the field's perspective back inside by surfacing patterns from prospect conversations to shape product direction and roadmap priorities.

• Create technical content that scales your expertise beyond the deals you personally work.

Qualifications

• 6+ years in a pre-sales solutions or sales engineering role, supporting technical products sold to technical buyers.

• A track record of owning the technical win on complex, multi-stakeholder deals with enterprise customers.

• Strong understanding of how modern web services and mobile apps are built, and the cloud infrastructure behind them (AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery).

• Professional experience in several of: ETL/ELT concepts and workflows, data pipeline design, message queuing patterns, API design and integration, web or mobile development, technical consulting.

• The ability to explain a hard technical concept to an engineer, a product manager, and a growth marketer, and have all three walk away with what they needed.

📍 MANCHESTER (HYBRID, UP TO 4 DAYS WFH)

💰 £70K-£90K (NEGOTIABLE)

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

We're flexible on this for the right person, if you've got management experience, or want to line-manage one or two designers alongside the IC work, let's talk.

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.

- At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. Lead Product Designers drive roadmap conversations alongside their product and engineering counterparts, not respond to them.

- Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

- We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

HERE'S WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO BE WORKING ON AS AN L6 LEAD PRODUCT DESIGNER AT STREET GROUP

- You define what success looks like before you ship, and you read the result against it after. Metrics, support data, customer feedback - you go and look.

- You have strong, well-formed views on AI in product design and have put them into practice. You can articulate when AI is the right design solution and when it isn't.

Are you a healthcare professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants more than “just a call center job”? myLaurel is hiring a Care Navigator, Level 1 to serve as the critical first connection our patients have with the myLaurel care team.

This is a specialized role for someone who wants to build foundational skills in healthcare navigation, clinical problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration - with real room to grow. You'll be the voice patients and caregivers turn to for scheduling, education, and support as they navigate their care journey at home.

We're looking for high-performers who are proactive, adaptable, and eager to grow within a high-impact startup environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Primary Point of Contact: Serve as the lead contact for patients and caregivers via high-volume inbound and outbound calls.

• Scheduling: Coordinate and schedule in-home and virtual care visits efficiently and accurately.

• Patient Education: Educate patients on myLaurel program services and set clear, empathetic expectations for their care journey.

• Post-Visit Support: Manage critical post-visit needs, including equipment coordination, pharmacy requests, and clinical documentation.

• Systems Management: Maintain high-integrity documentation of every interaction within our internal systems and Electronic Health Record (EHR).

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate daily with clinical and operations teams to deliver a seamless, “white-glove” patient experience.

• Ability to work 12 PM to 8 PM PST, including weekends consistently.

What You Bring

• 2+ years of professional experience in a healthcare call center or patient facing environment.

• Proficiency with Electronic Health Record (EHR) platforms (e.g., Epic, Athena, Cerner, or similar) required.

• A dedicated, private, HIPAA-compliant workspace with a door.

• Reliable high-speed internet (minimum 20 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload).

• Exceptional active listening skills and the ability to multitask across multiple software systems while maintaining an empathetic phone presence.

• High school diploma or GED required.

• West Coast Candidates are highly preferred and encouraged to apply.

Why Work With Us

• Join a mission-driven team bringing hospital-level care into patients' homes.

• Step onto a defined Care Navigator career path, with room to grow into senior and specialist roles.

• Fully remote role with a supportive, collaborative team culture.

• Be part of a high-growth startup transforming acute and transitional care for frail, elderly, and medically complex patients.

About myLaurel

myLaurel was founded on the belief that a meaningful portion of hospital care can - and should - be delivered in the comfort of home. As a tech-enabled medical group, we provide on-demand acute and transitional care to frail, elderly, or medically complex patients at home, helping them avoid the traditional pathway of ambulance, emergency department, hospital admission, and post-acute facility care.

For high-risk populations, myLaurel achieves 33% lower ED utilization, a 49% absolute reduction in readmissions, and a Net Promoter Score of 97. myLaurel has been named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and the New York Digital Health 100. Learn more at mylaurelhealth.com.

title: Principal Software Engineer- CRM
description:
POS-33519
 

Principal Software Engineer-  CRM Product Platform

Engineering | Remote - USA 

About the Team

HubSpot's Product Platform Engineering org is building the foundational layer that powers how millions of users experience, configure, and get value from the CRM. We own the shared infrastructure, APIs, extensibility surfaces, and product foundations that run across every Hub-  not one feature team, but all of them. When we ship, it shows up everywhere.

We operate as a product-line triad with Product Management and UX- which means tight, fast collaboration from problem discovery through production delivery. The org is in one of its most formative periods: we're redefining how customers interact with and configure HubSpot at a moment when AI is fundamentally changing what's possible in SaaS products. Engineers here don't just execute a roadmap - they help set one.

About the Role

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to lead one of the most compelling product challenges in the CRM space right now: making HubSpot deeply, genuinely configurable for every customer-  without sacrificing the reliability and consistency enterprise software demands.

The shift is already happening. Things that once required expensive custom engineering - personalizing workflows, building bespoke CRM applications, extending the product to fit a team's exact needs -  are becoming dramatically more accessible with coding agents and AI. The question we're solving is: how do you productize that level of deep customization at scale? This person won't just follow a technical roadmap-  they'll help define what's possible, build the custom workspaces and extensibility foundations that make it real, and raise the bar for how product-minded engineering gets done across a 100+ engineer org.

Key Expectations

• Architectural Leadership for CRM Configurability: Define the technical patterns for how customers can deeply configure and extend HubSpot-  from custom workspaces and no-code/low-code surfaces to AI-powered personalization that scales across millions of users.

• Zero-to-One Product Building: Act as the technical anchor for a genuinely new problem space. You stay current with where AI and coding agents are heading, prototype rapidly, and turn early-stage ideas into production-grade product features-  not just POCs.

• Hands-On, High-Leverage Contributor: You ship production code at 75%+ of your time. You lead from the front - moving from architectural vision to working software, personally. If your preference is strategy with others implementing, this isn't the role. You architect by delivering.

• Cross-Functional Influence at Scale: This work touches ~120+ engineers across multiple groups, plus Product and UX partners. You'll need to build alignment, communicate trade-offs clearly across all levels, and move a large org without steamrolling it.

• Technical Mentorship & Multiplier: You elevate the engineers around you-  raising the bar on full-stack product thinking, AI-enabled development, and what it means to build software that customers actually use and love.

• Product & Customer Obsession: You understand the pain of a CRM customer who needs software to flex to their workflow, not the other way around. You bring that perspective into every technical decision you make.

What You Bring

• Full-Stack Product Engineering Depth: You've delivered meaningful impact on both sides-  backend systems and product-facing layers-  and you own end-to-end. You're not purely infrastructure, and you're not purely UI. You span both because the best product outcomes require it.

• AI Shipped to Production: You've gone beyond experimentation. You've delivered AI-powered product features with real user impact-  ideally at the intersection of configurability, extensibility, or no-code/low-code tooling and AI capability.

title: 【医療機器審査員】【薬機法担当】- Japanese required, homebased
description:
We exist to create positive change for people and the planet. Join us and make a difference too!
Job title: クライアントマネージャー【医療機器審査員】【薬機法担当】（homebased）
Reports to: サービスデリバリーマネージャー
Location: 日本, 韓国 ,台湾 (Japanese required)

BSI は機会均等雇用を推進しており、多様性に取り組んでいます
役割の目的
BSI の「顔」として、クライアントマネージャー（医療機器）は、世界中の BSI 顧客と緊密に連携します。本職務は、アジアパシフィック（APAC）に拠点を置き、品質マネジメントシステムおよび関連プロセスを、 BSI 基準や医療機器規制などの法的要求事項に照らして評価することで、顧客のパフォーマンス向上を支援します。
各審査の終了後、クライアントマネージャーは審査報告書を作成し、顧客へ提示します。本職務は、規制の厳しい医療機器市場を主な対象とします。
業務範囲
当該職務の対象は、主にアジアパシフィック（APAC）に属する顧客です。
主な職務内容・責任 :

• 顧客のシステムやプロセスを BSI の要求事項に基づいて評価し、顧客およびその組織に付加価値をもたらす。

• 審査および審査報告を、 BSI の要求事項に従い適切に完了する。

• 薬機法関連の評価を実施する

• ISO 13485、ISO 9001、CE、MDSAP認証の発行・再発行・取消を推奨し、 BSI の方針・手順・期限に従って報告する。

• 計画的なサービス提供、適正な報告書作成、顧客との建設的な関係構築を通じて、 BSI の評判を継続的に高め維持する。

• ビジネス感覚をもって、顧客との対話において付加価値を提供する。

• 顧客対応では、常にプロフェッショナルかつ前向きで建設的な姿勢を保つ。

• 必要に応じて審査チームを率い、メンバーを適切に準備させ、サービス品質を維持しながら効果的なチームワークを促進する。

• 顧客との強固な関係を築き、長期的なビジネス関係を確立するとともに、事業開発や顧客満足度向上の機会を見出す。

• 顧客に対して正確かつタイムリーに情報を提供し、関連記録を適切に維持し、内部情報要件を遵守する。

• 業務を計画・調整し、時間を有効に活用して収益活動を最大化する。

• 医療関連分野の専門資格を維持・向上させる。

• 必要に応じて、研修・教育・人材育成・コーチングおよび資格の審査を支援する。

• デリバリーチームの一員として積極的に参画し、同僚や利害関係者と協働して、顧客第一を掲げた「Assessor Excellence」基準に基づく継続的改善を推進する。

主要業績評価指標（ KPI ）

顧客志向

• 幅広い医療機器メーカーにおける品質マネジメントシステムを効果的に評価できる。

• 顧客のニーズや期待を把握・解釈し、付加価値を提供できる。

• 医療機器および業界の専門家として認知され、継続的改善を支援できる。

• BSI のブランドアンバサダーとして、役割に誇りを持ち、約束を果たす。

オペレーション遂行

• BSI の卓越基準に基づき業務を組織・実行し、予期せぬ課題の解決に責任を持つ。

• 主体的に課題へ対応し、解決まで導ける。

• 経営層や同僚、利害関係者、顧客と効果的に意思疎通し、動機付けができる。

• コンプライアンス要件および BSI の卓越した基準を満たす。

コミュニケーション

• 不要な専門用語を避けた明確かつ一貫したコミュニケーションができる。

• 説得力があり、刺激的なコミュニケーターとして、クライアントに最適なスタイルで対応できる。

• 顧客に前向きで有意義な体験を提供し、「エクセレンス」の浸透を支援する。

商業的理解

• 審査から得られた知見を顧客に説明し、改善が事業パフォーマンスにどう繋がるかを示せる。

• クライアントの幅広いニーズに応じ、 BSI の他製品やソリューションを提案できる。

• 営業案件を適切に見極め、関係部門へ引き継げる。

• 自らの活動による収益への影響を理解している。

勤務条件 :

• 顧客先への出張があります。
言語の要件 :

• ビジネス英語

• 日本語

身体的な要件 :

• 主に出張に伴う移動
知識・経験：

• 医療機器業界で4年以上のフルタイム勤務経験

• そのうち2年以上は以下いずれかの分野での経験を有すること

• 研究開発または製造などの関連業

• 医療サービスや患者ケアにおける機器技術の応用

• 関連する国内外規格への適合性試験

• 性能試験、評価研究、臨床試験の実施

• 規制関連または専門サービスの経験

スキル・能力：

• 優れた口頭・書面でのコミュニケーション能力と高い注意力

• 独立して業務を遂行し、変化に対応し、時間を有効に管理できる能力

• プレッシャー下でも高いパフォーマンスを発揮できる

• 頻繁な出張に対応できる柔軟性

• 熱意と責任感を持つチームプレーヤ

• 高い業績を達成する能力

• 主体的で模範となる行動ができる

• 事業への強い情熱と周囲を奮い立たせる力

資格：

• 医療機器に関連する学位（例：電気工学、機械工学、生体工学、生物学、微生物学、化学、生化学、コンピュータ・ソフトウェア技術、生理学、医学、薬学、物理学、生物物理学など）
人間性・適性：

• 倫理的かつ誠実に業務を遂行できる

• 顧客のニーズを理解し、商業的視点から付加価値を提供できる

About Us
BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.

Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.
Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors - including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare - BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.
Living by our core values of Client-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society’s critical issues - from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between - to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.
BSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

title: Expert Assurance | Courtage & IA @Panora (backed by Hexa)
description:
À PROPOS DE PANORA

Panora est une plateforme d'IA native pour les courtiers en assurance. Nos agents IA automatisent les workflows à forte friction, cotation, comparaison de contrats, analyse des garanties, vérification de conformité, génération de documents et produisent des résultats structurés et actionnables en quelques minutes plutôt qu'en heures.

Nous accompagnons les cabinets de courtage en France et en Belgique, avec une conviction claire : le courtage en assurance est opérationnellement dysfonctionnel depuis des décennies, et l'IA est enfin le bon outil pour y remédier. L'IA n'est plus optionnelle pour les courtiers : elle devient le standard. La question n'est plus si, mais à quel point elle est bien mise en œuvre.

Panora a été fondée par Diane et Fabian. Diane a passé plusieurs années en capital-risque avec une solide expérience opérationnelle et connaît de l'intérieur les défis du scaling de business complexes. Fabian est un fondateur multi-récidiviste et ingénieur IA orienté produit, pionnier dans la construction de systèmes IA qui fonctionnent vraiment en production. Ensemble, ils ont décidé de créer Panora pour transformer les opérations d'assurance en avantage concurrentiel en temps réel pour les courtiers.

Panora est soutenue par Hexa (anciennement eFounders), le studio de startups pionnier en Europe, qui a lancé plus de 35 entreprises dont des licornes comme Front, Aircall et Spendesk.

POURQUOI CE RÔLE EXISTE

Nous avons construit une IA qui lit des contrats, compare des garanties et génère des analyses de couverture à grande échelle. La technologie fonctionne. Nous avons maintenant besoin de quelqu'un qui la rende brillante : quelqu'un d'assez méticuleux pour détecter chaque lacune, d'assez expérimenté pour savoir ce qui compte vraiment dans une police, et d'assez curieux pour vouloir façonner l'IA de l'intérieur.

Vous serez le cerveau assurance de Panora, la personne qui examine ce que notre IA produit, vérifie chaque synthèse, et réinjecte son expertise dans le système pour qu'il s'améliore en continu. C'est une opportunité unique de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur et de participer activement à la construction du futur du courtage.

VOS RESPONSABILITÉS

- Vérification des outputs IA, contrat par contrat. Vous examinez les synthèses, analyses de couverture et recommandations générées par notre IA. Vous vérifiez leur exactitude, corrigez les erreurs et garantissez que chaque output répond au niveau d'exigence qu'un courtier engagerait sa réputation à défendre. Votre œil méticuleux est la dernière ligne de défense avant que les outputs n'atteignent les clients.

- La boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA plus intelligente. Vous identifiez les schémas dans ce que l'IA réussit et rate. Vous travaillez avec les équipes produit et engineering pour réinjecter votre expertise assurance dans le système - améliorer les prompts, affiner le raisonnement, encoder les nuances que seules des années d'expérience permettent de saisir.

- Accompagnement client et confiance. Vous soutenez l'onboarding des clients et leur usage au quotidien, en aidant les courtiers à comprendre et faire confiance aux outputs de l'IA. Quand des questions surgissent, vous apportez la crédibilité et l'expertise nécessaires pour expliquer, rassurer ou corriger.

- Expertise assurance en IARD et Santé. Vous apportez une expertise approfondie en assurance dommages (IARD) et en assurance santé : les deux piliers de notre produit actuel. Vous en maîtrisez les spécificités et garantissez que notre IA traite les deux avec précision.

VOTRE PROFIL

- Expérience en tant que courtier, souscripteur, ou dans un rôle d'analyse technique des couvertures

- Expertise approfondie en IARD et/ou santé : vous connaissez ces produits sur le bout des doigts

- Méticuleux de nature : vous êtes la personne qui repère l'exclusion enfouie page 47

- Vous lisez un contrat et identifiez immédiatement ce qui compte, ce qui manque, et ce qui pourrait nui

title: Cloud Engineer (Tech Lead)
description:
At Luscii , we're creating space for care by working on multiple applications to help people manage their health. Together with healthcare professionals around the world, we build technology that helps patients receive the right care in the right place. Millions of people rely on our products every month through OMRON Connect, and behind every reliable healthcare experience is an engineering platform that simply works. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you will play a vital role in modernising the cloud platform that powers OMRON Connect, helping us build a more reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide.
OMRON Connect connects OMRON health devices with users in nearly every country worldwide, with an AWS backend serving several million monthly active users. Much of the platform was built by external agencies and still carries legacy: manual infrastructure, scattered knowledge, inconsistent observability and release processes that make adjustments slower and chancier.
The direction is clear: Infrastructure as Code, cloud-native and event-driven architecture where it adds value, safe continuous deployment, observability by default and teams that can ship independently. We are now bringing more senior engineering capability in-house and need someone to turn that ambition into concrete technical decisions, shared standards and a roadmap that teams can own. This is where you come in ;)
Your role
You will work across the Connect engineering teams, helping them make the right technical choices while modernising a live healthcare platform. This isn’t a greenfield architecture exercise. You will need to improve the foundations without disrupting a platform used by millions, and balance technical improvements with product delivery, regulatory requirements and the realities of working across the Netherlands and Japan.
You are going to lead through influence rather than hierarchy. That means creating clarity, facilitating difficult discussions, making decisions when consensus doesn’t come, and helping engineers grow into greater ownership of their systems. You may have a home base in one team, but your scope reaches across all of them. That’s why stakeholdermanagement and -alignment are key elements in this position.
What you will be doing, among others:

• Own and evolve the Cloud & Backend roadmap, translating the engineering vision into clear priorities, trade-offs and next steps.

• Drive cross-team architecture decisions to a close, making sure decisions are transparent, documented and followed through.

• Establish shared technical standards and guardrails that allow teams to work autonomously without creating unnecessary dependencies.

• Work hands-on with engineers on AWS and Terraform, reviewing designs and pull requests and challenging technical choices where needed.

• Coach and pair with engineers, helping knowledge spread across teams and supporting the growth of seniority and ownership.

• Work with product owners, QA, engineering leadership and colleagues in Japan to balance technical direction with product, regulatory, security and cost considerations.

• Help move the platform towards automated infrastructure, safer deployments and stronger observability without relying on a big-bang rewrite.

The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Working at Ohalo

Ever looked at the average file share at an enterprise? Millions of files, over-shared, unlabelled, full of personal data and IP. Nobody knows what's in them, and we've seen this stall AI rollouts and exacerbate security breaches.
It's what we've been solving since 2017. Data X-Ray discovers and classifies file stores at petabyte scale across an enterprise's entire unstructured data landscape. Then it acts on what it finds: surfacing over-privileged access before it gets exploited, pushing labels into Microsoft Purview, feeding DLP and SASE, redacting at source, and curating governed datasets the AI teams are actually allowed to use.

title: Senior BOM Engineer, Intelligence Systems
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Senior BOM Sourcing Engineer for Intelligence Systems (internally known as a Senior Product Sourcing Engineer), drives the strategic supply network development and cost management of Anduril’s product hardware across their lifecycles, by collaborating with suppliers and cross-functionally, including folks in engineering, quality, and manufacturing. You will be the end to end owner of supply chain for the Anduril Intelligence & Space business line, responsible for engineering support, vendor onboarding & development, as well sourcing, pricing, and negotiating for the total Bill of Material (BOM).

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Deep dive into your engineering Bill of Material (BOM), working closely with engineering to ensure parts being designed can be sourced & procured at a reasonable target level

• Conduct supplier selection for a specific product, leveraging our approved supplier list as well as working to onboard unique vendors to support the needs of the Space & Intelligence business team

• Drive on time delivery utilizing unique solutions to break the mold of traditional Space industry lead-times and supply constraints

• Partner with strategic suppliers to accelerate product development via activities such as:

• Concept scoping to quickly solidify requirements

• Feature trade-off/trade tables

• Should cost/clean sheet models

• Joint design development, via clear statements of work

• Simulation of mechanical & electronics designs

• Drive the development and consolidation of a manufacturing BOM, working with Engineering, Quality, and Manufacturing, to ramp production internally and with our suppliers with high flexibility

• Manage total cost of the program, including NPI & mass production  throughout NPI

• Conduct value-stream mapping to optimize supply network lead time and flexibility

• Complete the BOM risk assessment, include alternate component sourcing, etc.

• Ensure completion of all component qualifications, ahead of production

• Reduce complexity: commonality optimization & component/supplier rationalization

• Lead all cost engineering activities to converge the bottoms-up cost curve to product cost, maximizing the total cost of ownership (TCO) across the product lifecycle

• Manage ad-hoc cost issues e.g., tariffs / import export cost, and cost inflation

• Managing supply issues as they arise, ensuring on time delivery at or below target cost

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or other technical field 

• 8+ years of experience in sourcing engineering, supplier engagement and development, or design of electronics and/or mechanical devices

• Domain expertise of value/procurement engineering or TCO-related work at the component & product level

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

• Ability to travel 10% - 40% of the time, variable based on program needs

• Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Ashville, OH

• This role will be based temporarily at Santa Ana, CA for a 3 month training period before transitioning to Ashville, OH

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Master's degree or advanced technical degree

• Deeper experience within:

• Design & development

Immuware's customers, including Employee Health nurses; occupational health managers; and compliance professionals, work in one of the most requirement-heavy environments in healthcare IT. You're measured on customer outcomes, not on activity.

Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

At Vinted, the Security domain protects our marketplace across critical member touchpoints: Registration, Login, User Verification, Bot Prevention, and Authentication & Authorization. Every single member interacts with Security systems before making their first transaction.

As a Lead Decision Scientist in Security, you will serve as the senior technical lead responsible for bringing structure, clarity, and analytical rigor to some of our most critical trade-off decisions. While our Engineering and Data Science teams build defensive infrastructure and detection models, your focus will be entirely on measurement, evaluation, and decision frameworks.

In Security, every action comes with a trade-off: stopping malicious actors earlier prevents harm, but intervening too early or aggressively can frustrate or block legitimate members. Today, we have multiple restriction tools available-from verification challenges to account bans-and we need a clear framework to decide when and how to apply each one.

You will act as an autonomous strategic partner to Security leadership. You will own the analytical foundation for how we restrict malicious activity, quantify user friction versus harm prevention, and lead discovery on ambiguous, high-impact problems across the full user journey.

In this position, you’ll 

• Build decision frameworks for user restrictions: Design the logic that determines which restriction measure to apply (such as verification challenges or account bans) based on user risk and context.

• Balance member friction against harm prevention: Quantify the trade-offs between stopping malicious actors early and keeping the onboarding experience seamless for genuine members.

• Lead strategic cross-team discovery: Tackle open-ended questions across the user journey, such as analyzing duplicate/multiple account networks, assessing bot patterns, or evaluating third-party security tools versus in-house solutions.

• Own domain metrics and impact measurement: Build and maintain the Security metric tree, guiding target-setting so product and business strategies are grounded in clear, measurable impact.

• Raise experimentation standards: Guide best practices in A/B testing and causal inference in complex environments where traditional experimentation isn't always straightforward.

A Day in The Life
The Catalogue Transition team oversees the global transition of music catalogues from 3rd parties to UMG (Catalogue Onboarding) and the coordination of music catalogue loss of rights to 3rd parties (Catalogue Offboarding). The team is responsible for the initiation, ingestion, review and delivery of repertoire to digital and physical retailers, ensuring smooth migrations by maintaining the integrity and accessibility of the repertoire while coordinating with all relevant UMG departments and external stakeholders. The key objective of the team is to ensure that any new catalogue and/or label is distributed out to the market accurately, and up to current industry and artistic standards.
